texts.preamble: Raghuveer Singh vs State Of Raj & Anr on 11 May, 2016 Author: Anupinder Singh Grewal Bench: Anupinder Singh Grewal In The High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur. Order
texts.arguments: The petitioner has sought a direction to the respondents to not adopt pick and choose method while sending the candidates for Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Training for three months as provided in the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and Rules made thereunder. He has sought a further direction that he be deputed for training. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that the aforementioned training was discontinued after the enforcement of new Rules w.e.f. 2010 framed under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Therefore, as the training which has been sought by the petitioner has been discontinued by the respondents, the instant petition would not require any adjudication.
